evidence.description: 8 REQ (S1-S5, I1-I3, D1-D2) each map 1:1 to either an existing key-preservation guarantee, an observability field, or one of parent INV-1/INV-4/INV-P1. REQ-I1 explicitly cites parent INV-4 with mtime-snapshot verification method, satisfying manifest extraConstraint #2 (current run.sh:1-45 has zero writes under ~/loops/ — regression would be caught).
REQ-S3 explicitly requires BOTH disk AND launchctl rc=0 (conjunction, not disjunction), satisfying manifest extraConstraint #3.
EDGE-E5 enumerates the disk-but-not-loaded case explicitly with the same conjunction wording as REQ-S3.
REQ-I2 restricts gig-cli.sh invocations to idempotent start + --status read, matching the current run.sh:16-17 behavior and parent INV-1/INV-P1 (NEVER kill LAYER C).

Out-of-scope clause lists all 9 existing status JSON keys verbatim, matching the current run.sh:40-42 output keys (source, task, funding, earn_usdc, cost_usdc, jpy_earned, applied_total, core, wake, note) plus wallet — preserving main-loop classifier contract.
12 PROPs total; 11 required:true PROPs cover REQ-S1..S5, REQ-I1..I3, REQ-D1+D2, EDGE-E2, EDGE-E5. Each REQ-X has a corresponding PROP-X with the same identifier suffix — traceable 1:1.
PROP-NFR1-time-budget is correctly Tier 0, required:false — confirming manifest extraConstraint #4 that the <100ms NFR-1 is optional, not gating.
PROP-I1-no-loops-writes uses snapshot-diff of mtimes under ~/loops/gig/ — concrete, executable verification method; will fail loudly if any future commit adds a write.
PROP-E5-disk-but-not-loaded specifies the EDGE-E5 test setup (plist on disk, launchctl rc!=0 → installed=false), wired by name.

Purity boundary is clean: PURE helper summarize_loops_dir takes launchctl_print_rc as an injected param, so unit tests can simulate non-Darwin (EDGE-E4) and rc=0/rc!=0 (EDGE-E5) without invoking launchctl. SHELL layer is the only thing that calls real launchctl.
Test plan names 3 concrete test files (PURE unit, Darwin integration, static grep) — sufficient to exercise all 11 required PROPs in lean Tier 0/1 budget.
